meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 它按 6 阶段流程（任务启动、需求定义、商品理解、脚本创作、镜头设计、后期优化）为商品写带货视频脚本，采用「痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决」结构，并附镜头类型、运镜与字幕、配乐等建议。
howto.when: 当你要为商品（如宠物用品、美妆护肤、智能家居等）创作带货视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一条30秒抖音带货脚本，人群是25-35岁白领
say.note: 会按三段时间结构输出脚本和镜头建议

say.text: 给这款护肤品写一条小红书视频脚本，风格要简约高级
say.note: 会先定义人群、痛点与时长再写脚本

say.text: 这条60秒智能厨电脚本，帮我把镜头类型和运镜设计补上
say.note: 会补上特写、推、环绕等镜头说明

howto.what_en: Writes e-commerce product video scripts in a 6-stage flow (kickoff, needs, product understanding, script, shots, post), using a pain-point → product → resolution structure, plus shot, camera-move and post-production suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a product marketing video script (pet supplies, beauty, smart home, etc.) or e-commerce video marketing guidance.

say_en.text: Write a 30s Douyin script for this automatic pet feeder, for busy office workers
say_en.note: Outputs a script with shot and post-production notes

say_en.text: Write a Xiaohongshu script for this skincare product in a minimal premium style
say_en.note: Defines audience, pain point and length first

say_en.text: For this 60s smart kitchen script, add the shot types and camera moves
say_en.note: Adds close-up, dolly and orbit design
